newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Proton chairman feared killed in crash.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Proton chairman feared killed in crash.

text.p: The chairman and chief executive officer of national carmaker Proton Bhd was feared killed in a helicopter crash on Monday night, the national Bernama news agency said on Tuesday.
Bernama said the helicopter went down near Kuala Lipis, about 250 km from capital Kuala Lumpur, and that Yahaya Ahmad was feared dead.
Pahang state police chief Abas Johar was quoted as saying that three bodies burnt beyond recognition in the crash may include Yahaya and his wife.
Bernama quoted company officials as saying that Yahaya and his wife left for Kuala Terengganu in eastern Terenagganu state to visit his sick mother.
Yahaya also controls industrial firms Diversified Resources Bhd and Hicom Holdings Bhd.
An official at Hicom said there was no immediate confirmation that Yahaya was on the helicopter. Officials at his other companies were not immediately available for comment.
